description: Two-bot relay. The first bot does part 1, hands over and stands down. Whoever picks the task up next must finish it from the unit's documents alone: the handover says what is next, the Field Manual says how this unit works.

script.text: Split task #{number} in two: part 1 lays the groundwork, part 2 completes it.

script.state: Part 1 of task #{number} is committed on {branch}. Part 2 has not been started.
nextSteps: Write `orbot/task-{number}/part-2.md`: Part 2 completes what part 1 started.

script.reason: Part 1 done and handed over; standing down so another bot can finish.
